description: Build a Gretl function package (.gfn or .zip) using the native makepkg command. By default this also requires opening the generated workflow in the visible Gretl GUI.

displayInGretl.description: Open the generated makepkg script in Gretl GUI. Defaults to true outside CI.

index.description: Write the auxiliary package XML index file.

requireGui.description: Require the visible Gretl GUI to open for this workflow. Defaults to true outside CI.

translations.description: Write the auxiliary i18n C strings file.

name: gretl_make_package
